description:
The client contract: the TypeSafeClient interface, TypeSafeException, and the decorators
    that wrap any implementation (RetryingTypeSafeClient, DeadlineTypeSafeClient, TokenCounter).
    Depends only on typesafe-java-core. Implemented by typesafe-java-client-http (the TypeSafe API over
    HTTP) and typesafe-java-client-local (in-process models).
